scope: Independent nested-child arity review for the 12 archived URI COMA/proof JSON targets.
review_method: Read-only Why3 task inspection by Astra; no solver was launched. First-level COMA split task counts were independently emitted with the Why3 printer driver. Nested parents were inspected individually; a global second split was not used for totals because it also splits already-proved siblings.
observations: The first five pairs have identical branch context modulo axiom-label renaming. The two success pairs additionally alpha-rename locals, introduce the existing let-bound URI, and split the existing empty() post assumptions. Exact invariant/functional-post conjuncts were inspected.
result: No omitted child was detected for these 12 selected targets. The 55 expected terminal VCs are complete for this archived target batch; 48 are proved and 7 remain open. This is a bounded audit of this snapshot, not a generic replay validator.
global_second_split_note: A global second split emitted 13 and 33 tasks for the two nested-heavy targets and is not used to compute the expected terminal total because it also splits siblings already proved at the first level.
